summary: The GROUP is the component and the option is its item: RadioGroup owns the legend, the shared name, the selection and the error, and a <Radio> outside one throws rather than rendering something nobody can name. A real fieldset around real radio inputs, so arrow-key navigation, the single tab stop, form participation and the legend-as-part-of-every-name come from the platform and nothing is reached for. Checkbox's geometry with a circle and a dot — 18px control, 1px edge, 8px dot, 24px row — asserted as a RELATIONSHIP against Checkbox in the browser test rather than as numbers on each, so the pair cannot drift apart while both suites stay green. Carries a geometry spec: two cases, the options run and the control, which takes design-spec coverage from one item to two.
